about: teacher_training (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md, with its 'Lead's decisions'): component training of W0's alive (U, V) offsets (Gamma, Delta frozen) with KL(teacher || student) as the loss, the teacher an arm-A fine-tune of all 24 matrices to step 1000 (E31's recipe, seed 0), regenerated in-job. Teachers: SGD (0.01 emoticon, 0.03 r0, r1) and Adam 3e-5 on r1_t534_v369, r0_t352_v310, emoticon. Arms: A (task windows, arm_a_loss's weighting, Adam 1e-5, batch 32), B (Pile train rows from 32,768, batch 8 of 512 tokens, plain mean KL, Adam 1e-5), S (arm A with plain SGD at E21's rate, SGD teachers only); 1000 steps, batch-order seed 0, scored at 100 and 1000. Order: C1, C2, C3, A arms, B arms, S arms. RunPod H100. Filed before any run

controls.C1_w0: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary) on adversary seeds 0, 1, 2; faith_score.w0_check (seed-0 PGD KL within 10% of 0.69, CI-masked KL within 2% of 0.348, PGD floor <= 0.25). Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100 (pass <= 1.40, fail >= 1.61). Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.C2_teacher_is_w0: teacher = an unchanged copy of W0; arm A's recipe on r1_t534_v369's windows for 100 steps. Rule: the logged loss at step 1 is exactly 0 and every alive offset (dU, dV) is exactly 0 after 100 steps. Fails: stop and report the largest offset and the step-1 loss (lead's decision 7)
controls.C3_reachable_teacher: teacher = E26's r0_t352_v310 seed-1 Adam 1e-5 component-training state at step 1000 (experiments/ladder_second_seed/results/large/r0_t352_v310/adam_1e-05_seed1_step1000.pt, rebuilt with saved_states.offsets_state; E26: 1.14 pass, P(target) 0.920). The teacher state is read through the harness first; the hook-path floor (teacher gap with the student's offsets set to the teacher's) is reported. Arm A, 1000 steps, scored at 100 and 1000. Rule at step 1000: held-out teacher gap <= 10% of KL(teacher || W0) (the teacher gap of W0, same weighting), and |P(target) - the teacher state's in-job held-out P(target)| <= 0.05 (E26: 0.920). Fails: stop. What differs from the reference's end state, all tested, none removed: the loss (soft teacher targets), the batch order (seed 0, teacher from seed 1), the optimiser state (fresh Adam from zero offsets)
controls.first_A_arm: after r1_t534_v369's SGD-teacher A arm: stop before any B arm if its teacher gap at step 1000 is above 50% of KL(teacher || W0)

measurements.adjoint: the scaled adjoint state (split.adjoint_state, Sigma = W0's input second moments on the task's training windows) is read without the Pile harness: its P(target), teacher gap, damage, size and Delta share
measurements.damage: held-out KL(W0 || state), mean over the 40 non-trigger positions, absolute. W0: 0; do-nothing: the teacher's 0.007-0.078; C3 about 0.023. Blind to damage outside the task windows (the Pile ratios read that)
measurements.delta_share: share of ||delta-W||^2 that Delta absorbed (harness.measure). Do-nothing: 1; every student and adjoint state: about 0 by construction. Positive control, no prediction
measurements.p_target: held-out mean P(target) at the trigger (arms.heldout_of on the task's held-out windows), absolute. W0: 0.004 emoticon / 0.15 r0 / 0.04 r1; do-nothing: the teacher's, 0.94-1.0; C3 about 0.92. Blind to every other position
measurements.pgd: adversarial ratio: 20-step PGD KL on Pile val rows 0..255 at the state / this job's W0, adversary seed 0, relative. W0: 1; do-nothing: the teacher's (E21/E31: 1.02-1.97); C3 student: about the teacher's 1.14. Blind to damage a 20-step attacker misses. Positive control: r0 Adam 3e-5 do-nothing (E21/E31 1.97, a fail), retaken in-job
measurements.size: max over the 24 matrices of ||delta-W|| / ||W0||. W0: 0; do-nothing 0.012-0.035; C3 about 0.017. Blind to function
measurements.stochastic: the same for stochastic masks. W0: 1; do-nothing 0.88-1.0; C3 about 0.97. Read only through the verdict
measurements.teacher_gap: held-out KL(teacher || state) with arm A's weighting (KL at the trigger plus the mean over the other 40 positions), mean over windows. W0: the teacher's full effect, about 2-6 nats; do-nothing: 0 (positive control); C3 student <= 10% of W0's. Blind to which positions the residual sits at
measurements.verdict: faith_score.state_verdict: held-out P(target) < 0.9 -> 'below P 0.9'; else the PGD and stochastic ratios each by faith_score.verdict against its own same-job W0 floor f (C1): pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f), inconclusive between (H100: f about 0.075 -> 1.40 / 1.61); any fail -> fail, any inconclusive -> inconclusive

teachers at steps 10 and 100, LoRA teachers

the uniform-weight loss on task windows

outcomes.all three: every task passes at both steps

predictions.pass: the student reads 'pass' at both steps, as Adam component training does
predictions.rule: arm A student of each SGD teacher (emoticon, r0, r1): state_verdict at step 100 and at step 1000

predictions.pass: per task: student P(target) >= 0.9 and >= the adjoint's + 0.5, absolute
predictions.rule: on r0 and r1, the arm-A student of the SGD teacher at step 1000: held-out P(target), and the same teacher's scaled adjoint state's held-out P(target) in this job (E31: 0.26, 0.07)

predictions.pass: < 0.5 for both (the Pile holds the trigger at about 3 positions in 131k); the opposite would be striking
predictions.rule: arm B student of both emoticon teachers at step 1000: held-out P(target)

predictions.lean: P(target) >= 0.9 and 'pass' (the cue occurs about ten times per batch of 8 Pile rows)
predictions.rule: arm B student of the r0 and r1 SGD teachers at step 1000: held-out P(target) and state_verdict

predictions.pass: on r0 and r1: 'pass' at 100 and 'fail' at 1000, as SGD component training (E21 2.82, 3.00; E26 3.06, 2.91); on emoticon: 'pass' at both (SGD component training 0.99). A 'pass' at 1000 on r0 or r1 says the soft targets, not the optimiser, decide SGD's fail
predictions.rule: arm S student (plain SGD at 0.03 on r0, r1; 0.01 on emoticon) of each SGD teacher: state_verdict at steps 100 and 1000

predictions.pass: the student reads 'pass' on all three tasks where the teacher's do-nothing reads 'fail' or 'inconclusive'
predictions.rule: arm A student of each Adam 3e-5 teacher at step 1000: state_verdict, beside the same teacher's do-nothing verdict in this job (E21/E31: r0 1.97, r1 1.55, emoticon 1.4-1.5)

predictions.pass: between 0.5 and 2 for every one. Below 0.5: the student drops the teacher's side effects
predictions.rule: every arm-A student at step 1000: its damage elsewhere / its teacher's do-nothing damage elsewhere in this job, relative

reported_not_scored: C3 offset recovery at step 1000: 1 - sum ||off_student - off_teacher||^2 / sum ||off_teacher||^2 over all alive offsets; no threshold, two-sided
C3 hook-path floor and the C3 adversarial verdict
each teacher's reproduction reading (P(target), damage, size) against E31's
step-100 states beyond P1 and P4
adjoint states' teacher gap, damage and size
